phases.name: Despair
phases.say: If I fall, I take the light down with me.

say.open: What rises last fills the hall from wall to wall, and the floor begins to pulse.
say.death: The Pit goes quiet, for the first time in a thousand years.

bestiary.lore: The Overlord as he truly is: the Pit given a mouth.
bestiary.weakness: Holy and Water. Readiness damage still half-works on him: knock his clock back to delay the Doom Pulse.
bestiary.pattern: Crushes two columns deep and rains fire on four random cells. Every fourth turn it charges the Doom Pulse, telegraphed: a blow and 6 Sanity on every Scion. In Despair it pulses every third turn.
